page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a woodcut ornament above the title. The title is set in capitals and small type, followed by the dedication text with a large woodcut initial. Signature at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: AMPLISSIMO ET CLA-RISSIMO VIRO DN. NICOLAO DOBBINO, I. V. DOCTORI PRAE-stantissimo, Electoralis Palatinatus Consiliario intimo & dignissimo, Domino ac Patrono plurimum colendo.
main_text.p: TANTA gratitudinis & dignitas & efficacitas est: Vir Amplissime, Domine ac Patrone plurimum obseruande: ut vel mutae etiam brutaeq; pecudes, sine ullo rationis discursu, solo naturae instinctu, ob generisui conseruationē hāc virtutē penè æmulari, & non sine magna quan-doque admiratione imitari videantur; velut ex A. Gellij, Aeliani, Appionis Po-lyhistoris, Fulgosi, Egnatij, & aliorum, historia, quin etiam è communi expe-rientia, liquidò peruidere promptum est. Perquàm ergo scitè & eleganter M.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament above the title and the large woodcut initial "T" are decorative and not transcribed as text. A small mark at the upper right of the text block is a printer's or stray mark and is not transcribed. The title's last line is set in smaller type and is transcribed as printed. The word "ullo" is printed "vllo" (u/v corrected to vowel u). The text ends at "M." on a full line, which is text, not a catchword.
